source: #1889 (RFC 0004 §4.1); the coordinator's review of 2026-11-23 (sentences proposed in the PR)
statement: A principal id is not blank: neither empty nor white space only. Authenticated means someone, and the id keys the principal's sessions, revocations, rate limits and audit records. Each entrance refuses one in its own terms: a token whose subject is blank is invalid (401 token-invalid) on every path that verifies one, a request's and a refresh's, and CoSec's token issuer signs none; a forwarded identity whose sub, tenant or rid is blank is malformed (400), and a gateway writes none; an API key record of a blank principal cannot be made, so its lookup fails (503); a document binding a blank principal, a stored actor or a session record naming one does not decode; cosec-migrate names a 7.x API key of a blank principal among its rejections and converts the others. PrincipalId itself refuses a blank value, so an authenticator of the application's own that makes one has failed (503), as for IDN-10. An id is not trimmed: white space around one is part of it, compared as it is.
guards: model:BindingTest#a principal id is never blank
document:IdentityCodecTest#a blank tenant, subject or request id is refused as malformed, and not written
document:PolicyDocumentCodecTest#a principal binding names a principal that is not blank
runtime:BlankPrincipalIdPipelineTest#a token of a blank subject is token-invalid and decided as anonymous
runtime:BlankPrincipalIdPipelineTest#an authenticator whose principal is blank is unavailable
runtime:BlankPrincipalIdPipelineTest#white space around a subject is part of its id
control:StoredActorTest#a blank actor is a malformed record
cocache:TokenFamilyFormatTest#a session of a blank principal is refused as a format error
migrate:ApiKeyMigrationTest#a key that cannot be converted exactly is refused
migrate:MembershipsExportTypesTest#a blank principal is refused, naming the entry
migrate:MigrateMainTest#a blank platform administrator is a usage error
